content: उत्थान {%a.%} Causing to arise or spring up. .{@-नम्@} .²1 The act of rising or standing up, getting up; शनैर्यष्टपुत्थानम् <ls>Bh. 3. 9</ls>. .²2 Rising (as of luminaries); इन्दुं नवोत्थानमिवेन्दुमत्यै <ls>R. 6. 31</ls> newly risen. .²3 Rise, origin. .²4 Resurrection. .²5 .³({%a%}) Effort, exertion, activity; मेदच्छेदकृशोदरं लघु भवत्युत्थानयोग्यं वपुः <ls>Ś. 2. 5</ls>; ˚शीलः <ls>Dk. 153</ls> disposed to work; <ls>Mv. 6. 23</ls>; यद्युत्थानं भवेत्सह <ls>Ms. 9. 215</ls>, effort (for money), acquisition of property. .³({%b%}) Manly exertion, manhood, <ls>Mb. 10. 2. 6</ls>; राज्ञो हि व्रतमुत्थानम् <ls>Kau. A. 1. 19</ls>; also अर्थस्य मूलमुत्थानम् .²5 Energy. उत्थानेन सदा पुत्र प्रयतेथा युधिष्ठिर . न हयुत्थानमृते दैवं राज्ञामर्थं प्रसाधयेत् .. <ls>Mb. 12. 56. 14</ls>. .²6 Joy, pleasure. .²7 War, battle. .²8 An army. .²9 Evacuating (by stool <ab>&c.</ab>). .²10 A book. .²11 A court-yard. .²12 A shed where sacrifices are offered. .²13 A term, limit, boundary. .²14 Business (cares <ab>&c.</ab>) of a family or realm. .²15 Reflection. .²16 Proximate cause of a disease. .²17 Awakening. .²18 A monastery. .²19 Readiness of the army for fight; युद्धानुकूलव्यापार उत्थानमिति कीर्तितम् <ls>Śukra. 1. 325</ls>.
